clips.title: The story
paras: Barnil Stonepot is trying to reconstruct the thrilling finale of Hemet Nesingwary's famous manuscript. Recovering the final three sheets will restore the climactic conclusion to the wild hunting tale.

Barnil Stonepot considers this section the big finale of the entire hunting volume. To assemble the fourth chapter, he needs someone to track down and return pages twenty-five, twenty-six, and twenty-seven. Once these three lost sheets are gathered from across the jungle, the manuscript's exciting conclusion can finally be reassembled.

clips.title: Quest text
